Nina — thanks for the clear ask and the target date. I put together a concise MAP snapshot (attached) and an acceptance checklist that ties security gates to concrete artifacts we can deliver. Key highlights up front:

1) SOC 2: Redwood is SOC 2 Type II in production; our most recent report (Q2 2026) covers hosted and dedicated controls. We can provide the report and the auditor letter within 48 hours of an NDA.

2) SIG/CAIQ: Attached is a CAIQ mapping that calls out differences between Hosted API and Dedicated pools (notable: private deployments include HSM options for key separation). We'll flag any partial coverage items and propose mitigations.

3) DPA & retention defaults: Draft DPA attached. Default retention: 30 days logs (token-level prometheus traces retained 90 days), customer data retention configurable by plan. For EU residency customers we offer VPC/private deployment or a hosted region with EU-only processing.

4) Evidence cadence & owners (proposed):
- Redwood (Marissa): SOC 2 report, CAIQ worksheet, encryption configuration guide.
- FinTrust (Nina): legal DPA redlines, list of required evidence owners.
- Redwood (Ben): engineering readiness confirmation for dedicated pool and expected lead time for on-prem packaging (if needed).

Action items and timeline (proposed):
- Oct 19: Share MAP_v1 + CAIQ mapping + draft DPA (this email).
- Oct 21: FinTrust legal to provide high-level redlines and any retention exceptions.
- Oct 25: Evidence intake call (30 min) to confirm file locations and owners.
- Oct 29: Target decision date (procurement approval / PO).

Attached: FinTrust_MAP_v1.xlsx, SOC2_Evidence_List.pdf, DPA_redline.docx

If that schedule works we will prioritize the SOC 2 package to speed your procurement. Marissa / Ben — assigning specific evidence deliveries below.

Nina — quick note from engineering on timelines and next steps so procurement has clarity for the PO cadence.

- Hosted: all artifacts available immediately after NDA; no infra changes required. If FinTrust chooses hosted EU region, we can commit to EU-only processing for production traffic.
- Dedicated: estimated provisioning is 3 weeks from signed commitment. We can run an initial canary on a small traffic slice during week 2 post-provisioning if FinTrust wants an operational confidence check.
- Private/on-prem: initial packaging and validation estimate is 6–8 weeks; depends on access to a staging environment.

About data retention specifics you called out:
- Default logs: 30 days of request-level logs; 90 days of observability traces.
- Customer content: not retained by default in hosted; for longer retention we can add a configurable archive; that should be reflected in the DPA redlines.
- DSAR & e-discovery: we have a documented process; turnaround SLA is 14 business days for standard requests and expedited 5 business days for critical legal holds (with an appropriate escalation channel).

If FinTrust legal can return DPA redlines by Oct 21 we will prioritize the intake and schedule the evidence call for Oct 25 slot. Otherwise we can move the intake to Oct 27 and aim for decision by Oct 29 — still doable but will compress procurement timelines.
